description: This file defines the Currency model class within the Opencart Catalog Localisation namespace. It includes methods to retrieve, update, and manage currency data, including fetching by ID or code, editing currency values, and listing all currencies.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Model class for managing currency data within the localisation namespace.

methods.name: editValueByCode
methods.description: Updates the currency value in the database based on the specified currency code.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves currency details from the database using the currency ID.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCode
methods.description: Retrieves currency details from the database using the currency code.

methods.name: getCurrencies
methods.description: Fetches all active currencies from the database, utilizing caching for performance.
